description.p: More than messaging: secure collaboration for the French public sector

ul.li: Communicate securely with colleagues across government departments and public administrations through dedicated discussion rooms that retain conversation history and shared information.

Move beyond traditional group emails: create or join rooms dedicated to projects, teams, topics or events. Manage access and choose the appropriate level of information sharing within your organisation.
Stay informed without being overwhelmed: customise your notifications to focus on the conversations and information that matter to you.
Never miss an important message: mention colleagues directly and use keyword notifications to keep track of relevant discussions.
Enhance collaboration with integrations and bots that support everyday communication and productivity needs.

description.p: Tchap is the secure instant messaging and collaboration solution provided by the French government for public sector professionals.
It enables government employees to communicate and collaborate across administrations while respecting the security and confidentiality requirements of public sector communications.
